name: angular
description: Angular agent skills for generating modern Angular code, architectural guidance, and scaffolding new apps with the Angular CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Build and scaffold modern Angular apps
interface.longDescription:
Angular agent skills help coding agents create applications aligned with the latest Angular versions, idiomatic patterns, and current best practices.

This plugin includes angular-developer for generating components, services, HTTP communication, and architectural guidance on signals, forms, dependency injection, routing, SSR, accessibility, animations, styling, testing, and CLI tooling — and angular-new-app for scaffolding a new project with the Angular CLI and modern defaults.

Use it when creating or changing Angular apps, choosing reactivity and forms approaches, wiring routing or HTTP, or setting up a new project. The skills steer agents toward the Angular CLI and current APIs rather than outdated patterns.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Angular app with routing and SSR
Add a signal-based product list that loads data with httpResource
Refactor this form to Signal Forms and keep validation working
